summary: All four of my turn-1 findings are discharged, and two of the repairs exceed what I asked for. The preemption rule is now genuinely executable: 'owner' is defined as the file-08 or D-001 surface owner of the work item and expressly not the coordinator-as-drafter, coordinator capacity is scoped as a per-owner queue rather than a global gate, and the entry states outright that the two lanes are not globally serialized — with the global-serialization alternative named and rejected. I tested it on a concrete case and it decides: DR-004 Phase-1A on Lane R and D-029's disposition on Lane P share the evidence/retention authority, so Lane R goes first; DR-002 on Lane R and D-029 on Lane P do not share an owner, so both proceed. The measured-inputs table returns with three digests, all re-measured correct, plus the re-measurement clause. Decision type is present and names which choices are preference-laden. The no-blueprint caveat is back. Beyond the repairs, the entry closes a latent ambiguity I had not raised — every scheduled act now has exactly one lane identity, with the §3.1 instrument assigned to Lane R only. I raise two NOTEs and no blocking finding, and I CONSENT.

turn1Findings.C2-D036-02: LANDED-VERIFIED, and this is the substantive repair. The entry now defines the term the rule keys on: 'Owner, for preemption: the file-08 or D-001 surface owner of that work item (not the coordinator-as-drafter). Coordinator drafting capacity is in scope only as a queue: the coordinator drafts Lane R items for a contended owner before Lane P items for that same owner. The two lanes are not globally serialized.' Both readings I identified are closed — the coordinator is excluded as an owner, so the serializing reading is dead, and coordinator capacity is nonetheless addressed as a per-owner queue, so the rule is not vacuous either. The Alternatives section adds 'Global Lane-R-first serialization of the coordinator. Rejected: collapses the two lanes', which names the failure mode I raised. Tested for decidability against file 08's owner cells: Lane R DR-004 (Evidence/retention authority) versus Lane P authoring of D-029's disposition (evidence/retention authority) is a genuine same-owner contention that the rule resolves; Lane R DR-002 (Evidence authority + V1 coordinator) versus that same Lane P item is not, and both proceed.

The D-025-031 turn-2 and turn-3 drafts each carried a sentence of the form 'Whole-document pins of COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md support only the named sections actually used: D-000 grant and clause 3; D-001 definition of done, §3 routes, MF-6, SF-3, and the five readiness conditions; …'. objections.claim: Lane P step 4's per-disposition exemption keys on 'that disposition's own bytes', which do not exist at the moment the exemption must be evaluated; the sentence is readable as either a before-authoring gate or a during-authoring stop condition, and the two differ in effect.
objections.evidence: Step 4 reads: 'D-028 and D-029 may be authored when their owning authorities and evidence prerequisites permit, without waiting for steps 1–3 unless that disposition's own bytes require a named product or actor fact.' In this corpus's vocabulary the disposition is the Route B artifact that step 4 authorizes authoring — the adopted D-028 states in terms that it 'Writes no disposition' — so at the moment one decides whether authoring may begin out of order, the bytes the test names do not yet exist. Two readings resolve it and the entry does not choose. As a before-authoring gate the test is unexecutable as written and the workable substitute is the selector's bytes or the row's file-08 acceptance-evidence cell. As a during-authoring stop condition it is executable — begin, and pause if the draft turns out to need a product or actor fact — and the surrounding phrase 'when their owning authorities and evidence prerequisites permit' reads that way. I do not score this because the second reading is available and natural, and because the entry's own worked example, D-030 waiting on D-032, is derived from the selector's adopted scope rather than from an unwritten disposition, which shows the intended method even where the wording does not.
objections.proposedFix: Say which bytes govern — most cheaply, 'unless that selector's adopted bytes or the row's file-08 acceptance-evidence cell name a required product or actor fact' — or state that the test applies during authoring as a stop condition rather than as a gate on starting.

consentNote: I CONSENT on the merits. Both turn-1 MUST-FIXes are discharged at bytes rather than by assertion, and the preemption repair answers the harder of the two by making a choice the previous draft avoided — excluding the coordinator as an owner while still scoping its capacity. I attacked every axis the prompt names and the two residues are NOTEs I explicitly decline to score: one is hygiene against a known corpus-wide pin defect that the restored re-measurement clause already mitigates, the other is a wording ambiguity with an available executable reading and a worked example showing the intended method.
